review_method: PNG-only direct native display of three 1024x1024 sheets, each sixteen 256x256 tiles. Step125 EMA/raw also displayed for direct comparison; prior125 review and all125 PNG hashes checked. No model deserialization or inference.
coordinate_convention: One-based rows and columns in each 4x4 grid.
checkpoint_numeric_validation: deferred; previous guard was24% free, below25%; not retried during this PNG review

observations: Compared with125, originally source-like faces now show stronger distortion and changing dark neck areas; image quality has not simply improved with adaptation.
The clearly childlike r1c3 face and multiple female-presenting faces remain.

Bright rectangular/chin patches appear at locations such as r2c1, r3c2 and r4c2, with dark necks. Several look pasted onto the chin or lower face instead of forming anatomically plausible shirt collars.
Eyes and mouths show visible warping or texture changes, including r1c2, r2c3 and r3c2.
No obvious headwear in the fixed grid; this does not establish hat-free generation.
Raw250 is more legible than raw125: eyes, noses and mouths are more defined and the extremely smeared125 surfaces are somewhat reduced.
Consistent black clerical shirts and white tabs are visible, with predominantly adult masculine presentation. This is a domain adaptation observation, not eligibility certification.
Faces still have a strongly stylized/metallic gray treatment, harsh shading, uneven eyes and mouth/cheek geometry; r2c3 and r4c3 remain conspicuously distorted.
Several heads and backgrounds retain warped or doubled-looking contours. The grid remains below the requested photographic quality.
Face shapes, dark hair and smiles are narrower in variety than the source-like EMA grid; a fixed sheet cannot quantify collapse or unseen diversity.
The childlike r1c3 face, multiple female-presenting identities, source clothing and source objects remain, while facial distortion and darkened neck areas are more pronounced than at125.
False bright chin/neck patches are visible, for example r2c1 and r2c3; they are not dependable white clerical collars.
Skin, eyes and lips have unnatural texture or geometry in several images; identity variety persists but the appearance is not a valid adult male priest set.

comparison_to_125: Raw G makes limited visual progress toward more coherent clerical portraits, but still has substantial rendering defects. EMA remains in a mixed source/adapted phase and now has conspicuous chin/neck artifacts while preserving disallowed source age/presentation categories. No variant meets the production quality gate.
interpretation: The EMA half-life is20k images and the run has seen16k images; this explains lag as a possible mechanism but predicts neither later quality nor successful adaptation.
These fixed previews do not establish fresh-sample eligibility, owner attractiveness preference, or diverse photorealistic results.
Numeric validity remains a separate pending check. This review does not authorize deployment.
scope_limits: No model was loaded, no numerical validation retry occurred, and no generator forward or optimizer update was run.
Both active MPS jobs, the scheduled heavy CPU slot, all inputs and trainers were left unchanged.
Only this new hash-bound review JSON was written.
